decisions.reason: The modular plant concept (MMAK) already shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so the evidence supports keeping and expanding this option rather than abandoning it.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is a core product category with its own page in both years and costs little to keep, so its value is still being realized.
This flagship MMAK concept has a documented customer reference with Wiese Umwelt Service and quantified savings, which reduces uncertainty in its favour and justifies further commitment.
The shredders launched in 2024 are too recent for their uncertainty to have resolved, and keeping them is cheap, so the option should stay open.
The spiral shaft screens are a new 2024 option in an adjacent screening niche whose value is still uncertain, and the low cost of keeping them on the market favours waiting for more evidence.
